tagline: Arch-kernel Linux with Windows app support, Kali tools & Mac design

# KwamLinux Core Distribution Builder
echo "Bootstrapping KwamLinux Kernel on Arch Foundation..."
pacman -Syu --noconfirm base-devel linux-zen linux-zen-headers
pacman -S --noconfirm wine-staging winetricks kali-tools-top10
systemctl enable kwam-compositor.service
